posts.title: Observations on America, and a few on Ireland
posts.description: I spent some time in the US recently – three months in DC and three months in Chicago. A few observations on daily life, coming from Europe: Public FacilitiesUS libraries, playgrounds and community centers are excellent. Notably better than in Ireland. A bit of a narrative violation, capitalist US is actually pretty good at this. […]
